task_title: Curse range/cooldown tuning + enemy status-effect visuals

plan_review.notes: Reviewer forked on two points: (1) the aura should extend the existing per-entity status renderer pattern rather than add a second per-entity Graphics subsystem — adopted as a SINGLE shared Graphics layer redrawn per frame, which also removes the EID-recycling hazard; (2) the burst radius bump to 5 tiles was unjustified — dropped, radiusTiles stays 4 (16ft) and now exactly matches the new trigger ring. Also adopted: polarity derived from (stat, op, value) rather than stat alone, explicit attackSpeed visuals, tests for expired/persistent/multi-effect/tie cases, a natural-activation trigger test instead of forceActivateAbility, and FOV/corpse gating for the aura. Cooldown direction: reviewer flagged that shortening it contradicts the literal wording; resolved by following the literal reading (840 -> 960 frames) and surfacing the interpretation in the PR description for the maintainer.

rounds.notes: Full-diff review against the repo review contract plus the path-scoped engine/game/shared/tests instructions. Checked determinism, layer boundaries, per-frame cost in PhaserBridge.sync, EID recycling and lifecycle, fog-of-war/corpse information leaks, tint backward compatibility (0xaadfff preserved), downstream consumers of the curse trigger/cooldown (equipment-loadout-evaluator reads the registry dynamically), and regression coverage. No actionable findings.
